subject: Taxes
title: India's 30% Crypto Tax
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: India's 30% Crypto Tax.

hook.text: India shocked the crypto world in 2022 with a flat 30% tax on all crypto gains.

buildup.text: India debated banning crypto entirely. Instead, it chose the harshest alternative: tax it so heavily that trading hurts.

discovery.text: The 1% TDS on every transaction is unique globally.

twist.text: Indian crypto trading volume crashed 90% after the tax. Traders moved to offshore platforms that don't withhold.

climax.text: India's extreme tax shows that punitive rates don't eliminate crypto.

punchline.text: 30% tax, 1% per transaction. Trading volume crashed 90%.

quiz.question: What happened to Indian crypto trading after the 30% tax?
options: Volume crashed 90% as traders moved offshore
